name: jev-permission-gate
description: Uses TypeSafe's Jev to allow or deny routine tool calls in auto mode, and hands uncertain ones to the built-in classifier

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: From console.typesafe.ai/keys. Without a key the gate stays out of the way and every call goes to the built-in classifier.

gate_mode.title: Gate mode
gate_mode.description: enforce acts on Jev's verdicts; shadow only logs them while the built-in classifier decides; measure skips Jev and times the classifier.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: jev-latest, or a pinned version such as jev-1.13.0.
